title: See every app your competitor uses (and what to do with it)
caption: Their app stack is public. Here's how to read it, and the sneaky way to get their entire email playbook for free. #shopifyapps #ecommerce #competitoranalysis #aitools

beats.headline: See their *whole stack.*
beats.say: Every app your competitor uses is *visible.* Their reviews app, email tool, upsells. All of it.

beats.headline: Free. *Ten seconds.*
beats.say: Free tools, ten seconds, and then I'll show you what to *do* with it.

beats.headline: Move three is | the *sneaky* one.
beats.say: Three moves. The third one is a little *sneaky.* [laughter]
One. *Install* a free tech-lookup extension like Wappalyzer, or paste their URL into BuiltWith. You'll see their reviews app, email tool, upsell app, and tracking *pixels.*
Two. Read what each app *means.* A reviews app means proof sells in this niche. An email tool means they make money after the first visit. An upsell app means they push bigger orders.

nodes.text: Sign up with a spare inbox

beats.say: [surprise-oh] Three. *Sign* up to their email list with a spare inbox. Add something to cart and leave. Now their welcome and cart emails land in your inbox. Their whole playbook, free.

visual.prompt: Competitor app stack: [paste]. Explain their growth strategy. Which 3 apps should a small store copy first?

beats.say: Bonus. *Paste* the stack into any AI and ask: explain their growth strategy, and which three apps should a small store copy first?

beats.headline: Copy the strategy. | Not the *bloat.*
beats.say: Copy the strategy, not every app. Too many apps slow your *store.*

beats.say: *Save* this for your next competitor deep dive, and follow for more.
